summary: Yunnan Nantian Electronics Information Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides digital solutions and services for the financial industry in China. The company offers planning and consulting, SaaS solutions and implementation, cloud data centers, intelligent management and services, intelligent terminal solutions, and other hardware and software products, solutions, and services. It also provides cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, blockchain, information technology application innovation, and application scenarios; and financial technology, digital government, industry digitization, and general industry solutions.
